notes.title: Happy holiday! The new version is updated now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I wish you a happy holiday, and the new version is update now!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42152151/b0797811ef4a64bd1aaf9731f4359c5532486584.png

We received feedback that wanted to support online Multiplayer, so we tested and supported Steam's Remote Play Together! Enter the game to see the "Remote Play Togetehr" prompt, press Shift + TAB to enter the interface, invite friends to play together!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42152151/27d9776b63e991803469dfe7cdbdde2b6f057a41.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42152151/bf6f0117f376116bdc6eb963160c05ec2fe15896.png

In addition, we also support Steam leaderboards, which can be viewed by clicking "Leaderboards" on the main menu! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42152151/c3a33a1074c5eabe9e38dec1a413c1be16f24b3e.png

Have fun!
